title: Validating Digital Traces with Survey Data: The Use Case of Religiosity

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the gender distribution of Twitter users in the Politus database against national statistics (TÜİK) and a representative survey (TIDA) to measure female underrepresentation.

Comparing the distribution of age groups (<=18, 19-29, 30-39, >=40) in the Twitter dataset against national demographic data and survey benchmarks to identify the underrepresentation of older generations.

Evaluating the representation of users across twelve regions in Turkey compared to national baselines, noting the underrepresentation of underpopulated regions, and using Multilevel Regression and Poststratification (MRP) to adjust the estimations.
